purpose: Adapters for five strict nineteenth-century microscope-slide nodes emphasizing surviving scientific estates, serial teaching/research collections, historical register states, and bounded maker sets.
guards: A present collection total spanning the nineteenth and twentieth centuries must not be projected backwards; isolate pre-1900 material by series date, publication, label, register, creator chronology or item record.
Historical catalogue or section-number ranges are identifier namespaces, not automatically physical slide counts. Never subtract endpoints to manufacture a quantity.
An explicit nineteenth-century institutional count is a dated historical state, not a present survival count unless current object records close that continuity.
Person-name inscriptions and estate attribution preserve the source's level of certainty; do not upgrade 'probably by' or 'from the work of' into 'prepared by'.
Collection-scale proportions such as 'around one third' are not converted into exact nineteenth-century counts when the subcollection extends beyond 1899.
Box count, embryo-series count, microscopic-preparation count and individual glass-slide count remain separate quantity namespaces.

adapters.institution_scope: Robert Koch Institute scientific estate / Robert Koch microscopic preparations
adapters.target: official RKI Robert Koch history pages, historical-image pages and institutional publications describing the scientific estate
adapters.promotion_rule: Recover preparation labels, research episode and dates when available; retain 'several hundred microscopic preparations' as an estate-wide mixed-period state and promote only explicitly pre-1900 preparations to dated CORE_19C item rows.

adapters.institution_scope: MNHN Histothèque / Philippe Van Tieghem and pupils historical core
adapters.target: official Histothèque collection page, SONNERAT-linked records, publication references and type-material links
adapters.promotion_rule: Use slide labels, linked publications, type material and dates to isolate 1875-1899 preparations. Keep the current >67,000 total and the 1875-1914 'around one third' core as separate collection-scale claims.

adapters.institution_scope: Harvard Museum of Comparative Zoology Harvard Embryological Collection
adapters.target: official HEC page, MCZ microscope-slide collection pages and MCZbase series/specimen records
adapters.promotion_rule: Resolve embryo-series identifiers and series dates in MCZbase; preserve approximately 2,500 series and approximately 30,000 slides as whole-collection mixed-period totals and isolate only explicitly pre-1900 series for nineteenth-century item counts.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museum of Health and Medicine / Army Medical Museum Microscopical Section (III)
adapters.target: official OHA curatorial logbook finding aids, 1867 Medical and Microscopical catalogue, reception registers, institutional histories and current slide-collection pages
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture explicit nineteenth-century register entries, dates, preparers/referrers and section identifiers. Keep the 7,275-specimen 1876 state explicit, never infer quantities from section-number endpoints, and treat present survival as unresolved until a current object/accession record is matched.

adapters.institution_scope: Smithsonian National Museum of American History Joseph Bourgogne-attributed microscope-slide set
adapters.target: official NMAH object record MG.217544.01 and associated Smithsonian identifiers/images
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve the catalogue's 'probably' attribution to Joseph Bourgogne, two-box physical structure and stable Smithsonian IDs; recover individual slide subjects/count only from direct images or curatorial records rather than box dimensions.
